title: Icy Field

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Deep Frozen Ocean (over Water Surface), Frozen Ocean (over Water Surface), Frozen River (over Water Surface), Ice Spikes, Snowy Beach (over Beach), Snowy Plains (over Grassy Terrain), and Snowy Taiga (over Forest).

sections.heading: Description
lines: Icy Field is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is categorized as an Elemental field and can be found in the Evergreen Cave and Seabound Cave.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Cave will transform into this field if the moves Blizzard or Subzero Slammer are used.
“The cavern froze over!”
Frozen Dimensional Field will transform into this field if the move Purify is used.
“The dimension was purified!”
Murkwater Surface and Water Surface will transform into this field if any of the moves Blizzard, Glaciate, or the Z-Move Subzero Slammer are used.
“The water froze over!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Ice-type moves → 1.5x boost.
“The cold strengthened the attack!”
Fire-type moves → 0.5x decrease.
“The cold softened the attack...”
Rock-type moves → Ice sub-typing.
Snow & Hail lasts for 8 turns.
Hail raises the Defense of all Ice-type Pokémon by 50%.
Burn damage is halved to 1/32 Max HP.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Activated Abilities:
Slush Rush
Snow Cloak
Buffed Abilities:
Ice Body restores 1/16 of the bearer's Max HP at the end of each turn.
Ice Scales nullifies the user's Ice weaknesses.
This results in Frosmoth having 3 weaknesses (Fire, Flying, Rock) and 4 resistances (Fighting, Grass, Ground, Ice).
Refrigerate increases base power by 1.5x for affected moves instead of 1.2x.
Other Ability Changes:
Liquid Voice instead turns the bearer's sound-based moves into Ice-type moves.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Bitter Malice → 1.5x boost, 10% freeze chance.
“The cold strengthened the attack!”
Chilling Water → 1.5x boost.
“The cold strengthened the attack!”
Moves which receive an attack nerf:
Hydro Steam, Scald, Steam Eruption → 0.5x decrease.
“The cold softened the attack...”
Other moves: Buffed Moves:

All contact moves that have a naturally increased priority raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. This effect is shared with Defense Curl, Feint, Ice Ball, Ice Spinner, Lunge, Rollout, Spin Out & Steamroller.
“[Pokémon] gained momentum on the ice!”
This does not apply to moves that gain priority (Example: Grassy Glide, Gale Wings).
If the Pokémon loses Speed due to Contrary, the message displayed will instead be "[Pokémon] lost momentum on the ice!"
Aurora Veil can be activated regardless of weather.
Matcha Gotcha's restores 65% of the damage dealt.
“Warm tea tastes best in the cold!”
Other Move Changes:
Bulldoze, Earthquake, Fissure, Magnitude, and Tectonic Rage layer Spikes on both sides unless the Sub-layer is Murkwater Surface Field or Water Surface Field.
“The quake broke up the ice into spiky pieces!”
“[Pokémon] was hurt by the icy spikes!”
If the Sub-layer is either field, the field changes to those instead - see the "Transitions to Other Fields" section for more detail.
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Ice.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Ice.
Nature Power becomes Ice Beam.
Secret Power may inflict Freeze.
Shelter halves damage from Ice-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Ice.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.

This field will transform into Cave if the moves Burning Jaleousy, Eruption, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Lava Plume, Magma Drift, Mind Blown, Raging Fury, Searing Shot, or the Z-Move Inferno Overdrive are used.
“The ice melted away!”
If the Sub-layer is either Murkwater Surface or Water Surface, the field will transform into those instead.
This field will transform into Water Surface if the moves Hydro Steam, Matcha Gotcha or Scald are used 2 times, or if the move Steam Eruption is used 1 time.
“Parts of the ice melted!”
“The hot water melted the ice!”
“The hot tea melted the ice!”
If the Sub-layer is Cave, the field will transform into it instead.
Specifically, using Hydro Steam, Scald or Matcha Gotcha increments the counter by +1, and using Steam Eruption increments it by +2. The field changes when the counter reaches 2.
This field will also transform into Murkwater Surface or Water Surface if either is a Sub-layer and the moves Bulldoze, Dive, Earthquake, Fissure, Magnitude, or the Z-Move Tectonic Rage are used.
“The quake broke up the ice and revealed the water beneath!”
“[Pokémon] made a hole in the ice!”
“The ice was broken from underneath!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Elemental Seed boosts Speed by 2 stages and causes Spikes damage to the user.
This damage scales with the current amount of layers, with minimal damage equal to that of 1 layer. It is therefore possible to lose 50% Max HP from Spikes alone on switch-in with this interaction.
